name: WF-099 Seller Follow-Up Timing & Cadence Engine

parameters.jsCode: const input=$json.body??$json; const s=v=>String(v??"").trim(); const strategy=input.strategy??input; const intent=s(strategy.intent??input.intent).toLowerCase(); const urgency=s(strategy.urgency??input.urgency).toLowerCase()||"normal"; const leadId=s(input.lead_id??input.identity?.lead_id), dealId=s(input.deal_id??input.identity?.deal_id), threadId=s(input.thread_id??input.identity?.thread_id); const missing=[]; if(!leadId&&!dealId)missing.push("lead_id_or_deal_id");
